name: craft-telegram-bot-surface
job: Craft or hard-cut a Telegram bot to the 2026 surface: sparse slash menu, layered keyboard edit trees, Rich Message only, visibility, bot-to-bot guards.

inScope: Jobs-to-channels mapping and the final registered slash menu
Keyboard and edit trees that edit the same message
Rich Message-only product text with no MarkdownV2 or HTML paths
Visibility matrix, bot-to-bot guards, and deletion of dual paths
outOfScope: Token custody and webhook ownership cutover
Product truth behind the surfaced commands

inputs: Jobs the bot must surface and group context
Existing menus, formatters, and callback routers to inventory
outputs: Final slash menu (within budget) and help tree map
Visibility matrix and Rich-only wire proof
Deleted dual paths with tests and verification evidence

data: current menu inventory and wire methods actually used
permissions: bot token or test-bot access owned by the operator

failureSemantics: Any surviving MarkdownV2/HTML product send, unregistered slash overflow, new-message-per-step keyboard flow, or unguarded bot-to-bot loop is a failure; verification requires wire proof, not menu documentation alone.

outcome.observable: A Telegram surface with a registered menu within budget, layered edit trees, Rich Message-only product sends verified on the wire, a visibility matrix, bot-to-bot guards where applicable, and legacy formatter/menu paths removed.
